outcomes.intended_user_result: Recall accounting identifies the effective owner-authorized scopes when callers use the default scope selection.
outcomes.current_baseline: Dashboard recall omits scope_ids, results remain owner-filtered, but coverage reports an empty scope list and hides the effective scope boundary.
outcomes.acceptance: Default-scope recall preserves returned records and authorization while coverage.scope_ids lists only effective owner-authorized scopes; explicit scope_ids behavior remains unchanged and unauthorized scopes remain unavailable.

excluded_scope: No retrieval ranking, scoring, provenance, budget, or native attachment policy change.
No model, vector, graph, MCP, connector, external backend, schema, or database migration.
No live data rewrite or native OMP configuration change.
No remote publication without new explicit authorization for R6.

allowed_actions: create GitHub release with verified artifact

next_authorized_goal_ref: Horizon Relay after a concrete workflow is selected
